q.en: A cricketer moves his hands backward while catching a ball to:
q.as: ক্ৰিকেটাৰে বল ধৰোঁতে হাত পিছলৈ টানে কিয়নো:

options.en: Reduce the momentum to zero instantly
Increase the time of impact and reduce the force

explanation.en: Increasing the stopping time reduces the force felt, by the impulse-momentum relation.
explanation.as: ৰখাৰ সময় বঢ়ালে অনুভৱ কৰা বল কমে, আৱেগ-ভৰবেগ সম্পৰ্ক অনুসৰি।
